Fallout 1 and 2 are certainly interesting games, but they come from a time where an RPG was all about save scumming through the whole game until you were able to figure out all the right decisions. They are simply not games that you can "play through" in the sense as it's understood today, these are the kinds of games that you can beat in an afternoon with a walkthrough, but spend months figuring out without one. The essential skill needed to beat this style of RPG was to explore the game inside out through trial and error and memorize the best path.
